description: Current USD prices of up to 50 tokens in one call, across chains, in the order asked. A token without a price comes back with null price_usd. Each row carries price_time (when the price last changed), age_seconds (how old that is now), indexed_time and indexed_block (how far the chain's indexing has got); a row with stale true must not be presented as a current price.

address.description: Token contract address (0x and 40 hex digits, any case)

name: get_token_prices
title: Get prices of several tokens
